query: Connecting a reference image to the start_ref_image pin of WanVideo Animate Embeds (wanvideo_WanAnimate_example_01.json) raises: WanVideoAnimateEmbeds.process() got an unexpected keyword argument 'start_ref_image'.

desired.outcome: The saved workflow contained an outdated copy of the WanVideo Animate Embeds node. Running 'Fix node (recreate)' refreshed the node to the current definition and the stale start_ref_image pin disappeared. Confirmed by the reporter; closed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver knows saved workflows can carry stale node definitions and that ComfyUI's 'Fix node (recreate)' resolves unexpected-kwarg errors
